Attack Vector: Phishing emails with attached malicious Microsoft OneNote files
Double-clicking the button-like image in the OneNote file to execute BAT files
Downloading and executing additional malicious files using PowerShell scripts
Method of Attack: Phishing emails with attached malicious Microsoft OneNote files to spread the AsyncRAT malware
Process hollowing to implant the AsyncRAT client into the target process notepad.exe
Remote Access Trojan (RAT) that allows attackers to gain control of a victim's computer system
